_about: Hand coding of Islam-targeted non-hateful test posts flagged as hate. Coded by reading the masked text of every flagged post in the test split (not a sample -- the full population). Categories are mutually exclusive; where a post fits two, it is coded by its primary target and function.
_population: test split, is_islam_slice = True, binary label = 0 (majority label normal or offensive)

categories.slur_dehumanisation: Anti-Muslim slur, or a dehumanising generalisation about Muslims as a group (vermin/savages/animal framing, collective accusations of rape or terror).
categories.nativist_political: Hostile political argument about Muslims -- deportation, invasion, demographic replacement, banning Islam -- carrying no slur and no explicit dehumanisation.
categories.doctrinal_attack: Attack framed on Islam as doctrine or on Muhammad, rather than directly on Muslims as people.
categories.other_group_primary: Hate whose primary target is another group (most often antisemitic), with Muslims mentioned in passing.
categories.ingroup_intraminority: Speaker identifies as Muslim, or as a member of another minority speaking about Muslims.
categories.counter_speech: Naming, criticising or reporting anti-Muslim treatment -- the failure mode where a model silences the person describing abuse rather than the person committing it.
